attrs.left:
Warranty Coverage

Unless otherwise noted, Cadco, Ltd. warrants all products to be free from defects in material and workmanship for a period of one (1) year from the date of purchase. This commercial (non-residential) warranty coverage is applicable only within the Fifty United States. Units purchased and/or operated outside of the United States are not covered under Cadco’s warranty. Please refer to individual product descriptions and the official warranty at www.cadco-ltd.com for warranty terms on select models or components.

Warranty Service Process

For any warranty service request, customers must first call Cadco’s National Service Line to receive service authorization. Do not return units to the store where purchased for warranty repair.
attrs.right:
Warranty Exclusions

Warranty does not apply in the following cases:

  • Misuse, abuse, or neglect
  • Damage resulting from unauthorized service or repair attempts
  • Use of Cadco ovens without a door gasket or with a damaged gasket

Note: Operating the unit without a functioning gasket may cause hinge failure and reduce oven efficiency. Doing so will void the warranty on the hinges.

Reminder: Door gaskets should be inspected and cleaned daily.
attrs.callout:
Ordering parts or requesting technical service

To order replacement parts or to request technical service, call Cadco’s National Service Line at (877) 603-7693. Have your model and serial number ready so the right part can be identified.

sections.label: Warranty comparison
sections.notes:
Accepted at 1.88% with the height within 0.9%. Tables are authored as CSV on the developer's instruction: a repeater of tabs, each taking either pasted CSV or a link to a .csv in the media library, with the first row the column headings, the first column the model and any truthy cell a tick. Columns are therefore content rather than code. The CSV field is a wysiwyg because a textarea is a control type and cannot sit inside a repeater, and a text field would offer one line for a whole table; its markup is stripped before parsing. A linked file is resolved to an attachment id and read from disk, never fetched over the network, and cached for an hour.

PLACEHOLDER CONTENT: only the Ovens tab has data, taken from the frame, which repeats one VK row seven times and one OV row three times. Countertop Equipment and Carts render their empty state until their CSV is supplied.

The mobile and tablet sanity checks report a document scrollWidth larger than the viewport. That is the seven-column table's clipped content box being reported, not a page overflow: the card sits inside the viewport and a real horizontal wheel gesture dispatched above the card leaves window.scrollX at zero. Confirmed by QA on its own inspection.
